item.title: Website Updates
item.description:
Updates Log - ACPI Website 2.0

This page is a log of all significant updates to the second ACPI website (launched in the ACPI Annual Meeting, October 2026, to mark the Golden Jubilee of the ACPI)

22 October 2026, 2306hrs

Public launch of enhanced and revamped ACPI website by Bp. Simon Almeida in the inauguration function of ACPI.

20 October 2026, 2306hrs

Test launch of bare-bones version of revamped ACPI website. The foundation of the website is a Github repository.The static website is built by Hugo and served by Github pages. Hugo theme applied: Congo.

item.title: President’s Message
item.description:
President’s Message for the ACPI Website

Welcome to the Association of Christian Philosophers of India

Dear Friends, Scholars, and Visitors,

Welcome to the online home of the Association of Christian Philosophers of India (ACPI). Whether you are a seasoned researcher, a philosophy student, or simply someone searching for deeper meaning in an increasingly complex world, I am delighted you are here.

Since our founding in 1976, ACPI has been dedicated to a simple yet profound premise: philosophy is not an isolated academic exercise, but a living conversation. Rooted in India’s rich cultural and intellectual heritage, our association offers a space where faith and reason meet and ancient wisdom speaks directly to modern realities.

item.title: President’s Message on the ACPI Encyclopedia - 2026 Edition
item.description: As President of the Association of Christian Philosophers of India (ACPI), I am privileged to present this Revised and Enlarged Edition of the ACPI Encyclopedia of Philosophy, offered as a Golden Jubilee Souvenir marking fifty years of our Association (1976–2026). What began as a pioneering effort in 2010 has now matured into a more comprehensive three-volume work, reflecting the growth of philosophical inquiry among Christian thinkers in India and their sustained engagement with the wider intellectual world.

item.title: Membership Criteria of the Association of Christian Philosophers of India (ACPI)
item.description:
Original Membership Provisions

As per the original Rules and Regulations of the Society

4. Membership

a) Any person competent in Philosophy (through his degrees, publications, professional teaching etc.) can become a member if he is sponsored and presented by a member and accepted by the Governing Body, besides the subscribers to the Memorandum of the Association.

b) Every person, being eligible for membership as above, pays the entrance fee (revised from time to time) and the annual membership subscription (which may be revised from time to time), shall be considered to be a member of the Society and have his name enrolled in the Membership Register.
